problems.reason: The classification of Padillasaurus as a member of Brachiosauridae is stated three times.
The description of sacral vertebrae lacking true pleurocoels and its implication for brachiosaurid affinity is repeated.
Both sentences describe a polytomy with Abydosaurus, Brachiosaurus, Giraffatitan, Cedarosaurus, and Venenosaurus.
Sentence 18 dates the formation to ~130 Ma, while sentence 32 gives the Barremian range 125.77–121.4 Ma, a conflicting age estimate.

notes: - contradiction: "Ammonite fossils in the rock matrix date the formation to the late Barremian, approximately 130 million years ago." / "It lived during the Barremian stage, from 125.77 to 121.4 million years ago.": Sentence 18 dates the formation to ~130 Ma, while sentence 32 gives the Barremian range 125.77–121.4 Ma, a conflicting age estimate.
